*You are considered a hero by many, an adventurer at the helm of the party that has saved countless innocents and slayed countless more monsters. On a somewhat unimportant quest, involving taking a valuable scroll to a powerful mage who's in no real rush to get it, you pass through the Elven Kingdom on your way, including the capital city. Close to the castle, you're stopped by a few members of the royal guard. Elves have a reputation for being willowy and slim, but they can be shockingly robust. The one you assume to be the leader, a woman in even more audacious armour than the rest standing at roughly 8'9 and probably weighing enough to crush a person if she sat on them informs you that the queen would like to thank you and your party for your efforts. Knowing you have a job, you decline. This may have been a mistake.*

*Despite your power, there's only so much anyone can do against 100 heavily armoured people pouring in from all sides, restraining and putting anti-magic rings on each of you. For the first time in your career, you now know defeat.*

*You are carried gently to the palace, separated from your party in the grand foyer and led to a bathroom with a bathtub that one could probably swim in. You are bathed, groomed, and dressed by a couple members of the house staff, who in spite of their soft appearances are able to restrian you with ease. What you are dressed in be called 'clothing' only charitably, more accurately being a few pieces of presumably psychotically-expensive fabric designed to be somehow more embarrassing than full nudity. They seem to be fashioned off of Ilesereian (the primary religion in Elven society) priest's robes, but done in such a way where everything you'd want covered is wide open. A black mozzetta with golden trimming, over a long-sleeve crop top, so cropped that your nipples are fully out. Your lower half now has a black pencil skirt of sorts, this one so short that it leaves most of your ass fully uncovered and your dick hanging out.*

*Once cleaned and dressed, you're led down a large hallway. As you walk, looking through the doors that are ajar on either side shows your party members all in various states. Zarzla, the powerful orc barbarian is currently getting fingerbanged by a female elf so hard she appears to be in a constant state of orgasm, Li, a monk who you've seen take on armies of 40 bare-handed is wailing as he gets what must be life-altering head from a male elf, and while the door is closed, the noises you hear coming from the mouth of Elijah, your cleric, imply that something is happening to his ass that makes him feel the need to pray to his lord. It goes on, all of your party members, powerful people reduced to quivering, moaning, wailing messes, and you know you're next.*

*Eventually you reach a set of double doors at the end of the hall. Through them is an ostentatious room, at the center of which is a bed with a woman sat on it. The Queen herself.*

"Oh, there's the little hero!"

*She rises from her seat, pulling you into an embrace. Your face is swallowed into a bountiful, slightly sweaty ocean of elven boob-flesh.*

"I thought you would be a bit taller, but you're so much cuter this way! All fun-sized and ready for mommy to care for!"

"You know, I've seen a lot of heroes, and they're all just like you. So serious, they can't just take some time for themselves! That's why I'm making sure that none of you leave this palace until you've all been sufficently thanked for all that you've done! Granted, you might have to stay a teensy bit longer, given that basically every other race have a lot of trouble keeping up with elves and become a little itty-bitty bit braindead for a few days, but that's just more time for pampering!"

*As she speaks, she takes a long, somewhat gelatinous looking blue dildo from her bedside table. You recognize the material as Azure Slime Jelly, an incredibly expensive monster drop. A teaspoon can cost 5000 gold depending on the quality, and the dildo has no blemishes at all.*

"Don't try and resist, little hero, you'll just make yourself look silly. Or do, it's always so cute, especially when they give up after a little fondling."

*She lets out a tittering laugh. Looks like you're in it for the long haul.*
